Title: Register with valid details
Steps: 1. Fill all required fields with valid data. 2. Click Continue.
Expected Result: Account is created and user is logged in / confirmation shown

Title: Register with already-used email
Preconditions: An account with this email already exists
Steps: 1. Fill registration form using existing email. 2. Click Continue.
Expected Result: Error message shown; account not created

Title: Login with valid credentials
Steps: 1. Go to login page. 2. Enter valid email and password. 3. Click Login.
Expected Result: User is logged in and redirected to account page

Title: Login with incorrect password
Steps: 1. Enter valid email, incorrect password. 2. Click Login.
Expected Result: Error message shown; user not logged in

Title: Search for existing product
Steps: 1. Enter a known product name in search box. 2. Press Enter.

Title: Search for non-existent product
Steps: 1. Enter a random/non-existent term. 2. Press Enter.

Title: Add product to cart
Steps: 1. Select quantity. 2. Click Add to Cart.
Expected Result: Product appears in cart with correct quantity

Title: Remove product from cart
Preconditions: Cart has at least one item
Steps: 1. Go to cart. 2. Click Remove on an item.
Expected Result: Item is removed; cart total updates correctly

Title: Checkout as guest
Steps: 1. Proceed to checkout. 2. Select guest checkout. 3. Fill shipping/billing. 4. Confirm order.
Expected Result: Order is placed and confirmation is shown

Title: Checkout with empty cart
Steps: 1. Attempt to go to checkout directly.
Expected Result: User is blocked/redirected with an appropriate message

Title: Payment with valid test details
Steps: 1. Enter valid test payment details. 2. Confirm.
Expected Result: Payment is accepted and order confirmed

Title: Payment with invalid card details
Expected Result: Error message shown; order not placed
